items.title: Tool calls are proposals: a gateway security checklist
items.summary: Production notes on dividing security decisions between an LLM gateway and the application behind it, drawn from a secure-gateway design guide.The load-bearing sentence: a model response is not authorization, and a valid tool call is not proof that the action should execute. The gateway authenticates the application and applies request policy; the application decides what each user may actually do.Gateway side:One integration key instead of provider keys scattered across services.
